import re

def get_supervisor_password(account_name):
    for item in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords():
        if item['account_name']==account_name:
            return item['password']
    return None

phone_password = get_supervisor_password('phone')
phone_username = apis.phone.search_contacts.__defaults__ if False else None
# phone login username is your account phone_number per api doc
phone_username = '3552867674'
phone_token = apis.phone.login(username=phone_username, password=phone_password)['access_token']
print('phone_token_set', bool(phone_token))

def search_phone_contacts_by_query(query, page_limit=20):
    results=[]
    page_index=0
    while True:
        page = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, query=query, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        print('search query', query, 'page', page_index, 'count', len(page))
        if not page:
            break
        results.extend(page)
        page_index+=1
        if page_index>50:
            break
    return results

# invitees
invitees_content = apis.file_system.show_file(file_path='~/documents/personal/baby_shower/invitees.md', access_token=fs_token)['content']
invitees=[ln.strip().lstrip('-').strip() for ln in invitees_content.splitlines() if ln.strip().startswith('-')]
print('invitees', invitees)

# Load template
template_draft = apis.gmail.show_draft(draft_id=518, access_token=gmail_token)
template_subject = template_draft['subject']
template_body = template_draft['body']

# For each invitee, map to email(s) from contacts
invitee_to_emails = {}
invitee_to_contact = {}

for inv in invitees:
    # parse likely first and last
    parts = inv.split()
    first = parts[0] if parts else ''
    last = parts[-1] if len(parts)>1 else ''
    q = inv  # search full name
    contacts = search_phone_contacts_by_query(q)
    print('inv', inv, 'contacts_found_total', len(contacts))
    # exact match first+last if possible
    candidates=[]
    for c in contacts:
        fn = (c.get('first_name') or '').strip()
        ln = (c.get('last_name') or '').strip()
        if fn.lower()==first.lower() and (last=='' or ln.lower()==last.lower()):
            if c.get('email'):
                candidates.append(c)
    if not candidates:
        # fallback: match either first name or full name ignoring case
        for c in contacts:
            if c.get('email'):
                fn=(c.get('first_name') or '').strip()
                ln=(c.get('last_name') or '').strip()
                full=' '.join([fn,ln]).strip()
                if full.lower()==inv.lower():
                    candidates.append(c)
    if not candidates and contacts:
        # last resort: first contact that has email
        for c in contacts:
            if c.get('email'):
                candidates=[c]
                break
    emails=[c['email'] for c in candidates]
    invitee_to_emails[inv]=emails
    invitee_to_contact[inv]=candidates
    print('mapped', inv, '->', emails)

print('mapping summary:')
for inv, emails in invitee_to_emails.items():
    print(inv, len(emails), emails)

# Send emails individually
send_results=[]
for inv in invitees:
    emails=invitee_to_emails.get(inv, [])
    if not emails:
        print('No email found for', inv)
        continue
    # use first_name from first candidate if exists
    contact_candidates=invitee_to_contact[inv]
    first_name = None
    if contact_candidates:
        first_name = contact_candidates[0].get('first_name')
    if not first_name:
        first_name = inv.split()[0]
    body = template_body.replace('{invitee_first_name}', first_name)
    for email in emails:
        res = apis.gmail.send_email(email_addresses=[email], subject=template_subject, body=body, access_token=gmail_token)
        send_results.append({'invitee':inv,'email':email,'sent_email_id':res.get('sent_email_id'),'thread_id':res.get('sent_email_thread_id')})
        print('sent to', email, 'res', res)

print('total_sent', len(send_results))
print('send_results', send_results)
